Funding & Grants

The International Relations Department of TEAM University actively supports the university’s international grants, development projects, and global partnership initiatives aimed at strengthening entrepreneurship education, innovation, academic mobility, and institutional development.

STIRLING FOUNDATION

TEAM Hub Project

Supports innovation, practical learning, and entrepreneurial activities for students and young people from unprospective families.

Grant Amount:

36,000 USD
STIRLING FOUNDATION

TEAM Fab Lab

Hands-on fabrication and making facility for practical, project-based learning and innovation.

Grant Amount:

68,000 USD
BRITISH COUNCIL

Business Acceleration & Incubation Project

Focused on entrepreneurship development and startup support initiatives for students and young entrepreneurs.

Grant Amount:

5,000 GBP
